# Savi Saluwadana

> Savi Saluwadana is a software and product engineer based in Sri Lanka, focused on software architecture, systems design, Go, Kubernetes and developer platforms, with interests in agentic systems and open-source development.

This is a public portfolio with product-level architecture summaries. It does not claim that every project is commercially deployed or production-certified.

## Engineering insights

- [Engineering insights](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/): Technical notes on software architecture, Go, PostgreSQL, platform engineering, MCP and durable agentic systems.
- [MCP Permission Boundaries](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/mcp-permission-boundaries/): Keep agent tools behind the authenticated application API and retain authorization in domain services.
- [Durable Agentic Workflows](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/durable-agentic-workflows/): Persist workflow state, design safe retries and model human approval explicitly.
- [Go Modular Monolith for SaaS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/go-modular-monolith-saas/): Use explicit domain boundaries before introducing distributed-service complexity.
- [Platform Engineering Paved Roads](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/platform-engineering-paved-road/): Standardize delivery while keeping state, observability, ownership and escape hatches visible.
- [PostgreSQL Multi-Tenancy Boundaries](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/postgres-multitenancy-boundaries/): Resolve tenant context before data access and treat database isolation as defense in depth.

## Product overview and architecture

- [Avara Real Estate](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/avara/): Property discovery, transactions and host operations in Sri Lanka.
- [Blu.lk](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/blu/): Home-service discovery, booking and fulfillment in Sri Lanka.
- [FreshPick / FreshOnTime](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/freshpick/): Food commerce, producer onboarding and scheduled recurring deliveries in Colombo.
- [TimelyHelp.lk](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/timelyhelp/): Product and frontend work for practitioner discovery and consultation journeys.
- [DevRelOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/devrelos/): A self-hosted beta for discovery, engagement and outcome measurement.
- [Property Management OS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/property-os/): Multi-tenant rental operations and controlled agent-assisted work.
- [RapidReach](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/rapidreach/): Developer publishing and tool discovery with a small CMS.
- [Advance HRIS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/advance-hris/): Hybrid web and local-first desktop HR operations.
- [NexusPOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/nexus-pos/): Checkout and store operations with an optional Electron desktop shell.
- [Academix](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/academix/): Student, academic and fee operations in a role-aware workspace.
- [Acme Accounting](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/acme-accounting/): Single-company financial operations backed by a double-entry ledger.
- [EventOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/eventos/): Quick provider matching and full event procurement.
- [Plate Restaurant OS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/restaurantos/): Restaurant point of sale and coordinated order operations.
- [Pain Intelligence Lab](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/pain-intelligence/): Cross-source pain research and evidence-backed opportunity validation.
- [Ad Performance Analysis Agent](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/ad-performance-agent/): An advertising analytics and reporting prototype.
- [MediCare](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/medicare/): Patient administration, appointments, clinical records and billing.
